title: CMU Course Reviews - Fan Pu Zeng
description: Reviews and Recommendations for Computer Science and Math Courses at CMU. Note that my experiences with some of these courses can be highly dependent on the professors, or due to the impact of virtual classes during the COVID-19 pandemic. Do also check out the CMU Online page for a curation of courses whose lectures and course content are publicly available. Course background: I graduated with a B.S in Computer Science (2018-2022) with two concentrations: Algorithms and Complexity and Computer Systems, and a minor in Mathematical Sciences. I then did a M.S in Computer Science (2022-2023), with a mostly ML, theory, and stats-heavy courseload. Courses with a ⭐ are those that I found transformative, and those with a ❤️ are those that I enjoyed a lot. I don’t write much about the more popular introductory or required courses, since there’s already a lot of word about it on the street and there isn’t much for me to add which already hasn’t been said.
